gizmo.title: Ukuqaliswa kwesixhobo sangaphandle
gizmo.description: Ibhloko evula isixhobo sokufunda sangaphandle kwifestile entsha okanye ephepheni, njengekhonkco eliqhelekileyo okanye ngesicelo sokungena se-LTI 1.3.

configure.title: Inkcazelo
configure.description: Oko abafundi bakwenzayo kwisixhobo, kuboniswa ngaphezulu kweqhosha.

configure.title: I-URL yokuqalisa
configure.description: Idilesi yesixhobo. Kufuneka ibe yidilesi epheleleyo eqala nge-https:// okanye http://.

configure.title: Vula kwi
configure.description: Ifestile entsha isebenza nazo zonke izixhobo. Kweli phepha kusebenza kuphela nezixhobo ezivumela ukuboniswa ngaphakathi kwenye isayithi.

advanced.title: I-URL yokungena ye-LTI
advanced.description: LTI 1.3 kuphela: idilesi yokuqalisa ukungena kwesixhobo. Ngale, i-ID yomthengi ne-ID yokusasaza, iqhosha lithumela isicelo sokungena se-LTI endaweni yokuvula ikhonkco eliqhelekileyo. Ukugqiba ukuqaliswa kufuna inkonzo ye-LTI yale sayithi.

advanced.title: I-ID yomthengi ye-LTI
advanced.description: I-ID yomthengi isixhobo esiyinike le sayithi. Isichongi sikawonke-wonke, ayiyonto eyimfihlo: ungaze ubeke izitshixo okanye iimfihlo apha.

advanced.title: I-ID yokusasaza ye-LTI
advanced.description: I-ID yokusasaza isixhobo esiyinike le sayithi. Isichongi sikawonke-wonke, ayiyonto eyimfihlo.

advanced.title: Umkhuphi we-LTI
advanced.description: Idilesi echonga le sayithi kwisixhobo. Shiya kungenanto ukusebenzisa idilesi yesayithi ekuyo iphepha.

advanced.title: Ukuphakama ephepheni
advanced.description: Ukuphakama kwesixhobo xa sivuleka kweli phepha, ngeepikseli (200 ukuya ku-2000).

advanced.title: Umbala wogxininiso
advanced.description: Umbala wetshiphu yesihloko neqhosha. Shiya kungenanto ukulandela umxholo.

developer.title: Ingcebiso yokungena ye-LTI
developer.description: Ixabiso elingacacanga elisetyenziswa yinkonzo ye-LTI yale sayithi ukuqonda umfundi. Ngesiqhelo linikezelwa yisayithi ngesiganeko se-lti-launch-request kunokuba ligcinwe apha. Asingoze ligama lokugqitha okanye isitshixo.

developer.title: Ingcebiso yomyalezo ye-LTI
developer.description: Ixabiso elingacacanga elisetyenziswa yinkonzo ye-LTI yale sayithi ukuqonda oku kuqaliswa. Ngesiqhelo linikezelwa yisayithi kunokuba ligcinwe apha.
